editType.description:
Type of edit
If 'create', a new asset is being created
If 'move', an existing asset is being moved to a new parent
If 'remove', an existing asset is being removed, along with all its children
If removing a single asset, its children will also have `move` entries with `parentId` set to the parent of the asset being removed

name.description: If creating a new asset, the name of the asset

parentId.description: The new parent of this asset if it is being moved

depthOffset.description:
If the asset is being moved, the difference in depth from the original position
If the asset is being created, the original depth is treated as 0, so this will be the depth

newFieldValues.description: The field values to give this asset when a `create` edit is applied. Is not applicable for `move` or `remove` edits.

deleteChildren.description:
The field that represents if the child Assets need to be deleted for 'remove'
if true deletes all the child assets along with the selected Asset

title: Type to hold information about asset hierarchy edits done through Asset Onboarding UI
name: AssetOnboardingEditInfo
